name: ledger-asset-management
description: Asset management for a corporate office — Django API + React client

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && cd backend && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/python manage.py migrate && .venv/bin/python manage.py seed
scripts.dev:lan: IP=$(ipconfig getifaddr en0 || hostname -I | awk '{print $1}'); echo "\n  Open on phones: http://$IP:5173  (survey: http://$IP:5173/survey)\n"; FRONTEND_URL=http://$IP:5173 concurrently -k -n api,web -c gray,white "cd backend && .venv/bin/python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8000" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
